description: This file contains utility code for parsing host and port information from network addresses and constructing HTTP URL strings with proper formatting. It defines a data structure for host and port pairing and helper functions for parsing and URL string generation.

classes.name: SettingsHostPort
classes.description: A simple data structure representing a network host and port pairing.

methods.name: parseHostPort(from:)
methods.description: Parses a string representing a network address into a SettingsHostPort object, extracting the host and port parts with support for IPv6 notation.

methods.name: httpURLString(host:port:fallback:)
methods.description: Constructs an HTTP URL string from the given host and port, adding brackets around the host if it contains colons (IPv6), or returns a fallback URL if host or port is nil.
